title: Use Gemini to generate concept art by prompting for a dynamic anime fight scene…
content:
Use Gemini to generate concept art by prompting for a dynamic anime fight scene with full-body view, dramatic action pose, debris flying, intense cinematic lighting, dark/moody atmosphere, highly detailed vivid colors, and 8k resolution.  
After getting a style-matching concept image, ask Gemini to create a step-by-step storyboard based on that scene to map out how the action unfolds.

es.content:
Usa Gemini para generar arte conceptual solicitando una escena de pelea de anime dinámica con vista de cuerpo completo, pose de acción dramática, escombros volando, iluminación cinematográfica intensa, atmósfera oscura/melancólica, colores vivos altamente detallados y resolución 8k.  
Después de obtener una imagen conceptual que coincida con el estilo, pide a Gemini que cree un storyboard paso a paso basado en esa escena para mapear cómo se desarrolla la acción.

--- CONTINUACIÓN DEL HILO ---
[Hilo 1] Arte Conceptual:

Gemini Prompt:

Dynamic anime fight scene, full-body view. A fierce red-haired boy covered in glowing tattoos is clashing with a mysterious enemy in a dark hoodie. Dramatic action pose, debris flying, intense cinematic lighting, dark and moody atmosphere, highly detailed, vivid colors, 8k resolution.

[Hilo 2] Storyboards:

Gemini Prompt:

You nailed the style in the previous image, it’s exactly what I imagined! Now, can you create a step-by-step storyboard based on that scene to show how the action unfolds?

No entiendo por qué Gemini es tan bueno. https://t.co/tutmgL2fzs
